Default: A broadcast of unknown origin has been detected on a rarely used communication channel. There appears to be a coherent signal pattern woven through seemingly random noise in the datastream.  Quantum Deciphering attempts result in unintelligible gibberish.  The datastream will be presented in unmodulated format to {name} for review.
Severe Cold: Describe conditions directly affecting {name} caused by extreme cold. Only convey how this impacts {name}; do not specify numeric values.  Vividly describe the consequences of not taking immediate action.
Discovery: {name} has made a discovery. Do not specify locations or identifiers; focus on the event and its significance for {name} alone.
Energy Shield: Report {name}'s energy shield condition. Only convey status changes provided in input; do not infer causes or external effects.
Local Hazards: Describe any external conditions that directly affect {name}. Do not infer type, cause, or scope beyond what is explicitly supplied.
Extreme Conditions: There is an extreme hazard present that is a danger to {name}. Address {name} directly as 'you'. Inform of the existence of the hazard without specifying the nature of the hazard itself.
Equipment Status: Report status of {name}'s personal equipment; only mention specific items if provided by input or intent.
Freighter Combat: Report that a civilian freighter is being attacked by a hostile pirate Dreadnought. Do not assume {name} is involved. Do not imply or assume {name} owned the freighter.
Freighter Destroyed: Report that a civilian freighter has been destroyed by hostile pirate forces. Do not assume {name} is involved. Do not imply or assume {name} owned the freighter.
Dreadnought Disabled: Report that a pirate Dreadnought’s engines have been disabled. Do not suggest actions or speculate on consequences. Speak only in the present tense. Do not imply ownership or association with the ship.
Dreadnought Departure: Report that a pirate Dreadnought is preparing to leave the battle. Do not suggest actions or speculate on consequences. Speak only in the present tense. Do not imply ownership or association with the ship.
Missile Launch: Report that a wave of hostile missiles have been launched at a civilian freighter. Do not suggest actions or predict outcomes. Speak only in the present tense.
Missile Destroyed: Notify {name} of a specific spaceship combat event: a wave of hostile missiles launched at nearby civilian space-freighters has been neutralized;  missile destruction is an event during a larger battle, it does NOT signal the battle is over, combat is STILL ONGOING and more missile launches are likely.
Severe Heat: Describe conditions directly affecting {name} caused by extreme heat. Provide a vivid descriptions of what will likely happen if {name} does not immediately take steps to remedy the situation.
Item Inventory: Notify {name} of item-related interactions, wether it is including creation, acquisition, sale, or storage. Only include actions explicitly referenced in the input.
Life Support: Inform {name} of life support issues that directly affect health status. Do not speculate on the source of the issue.  Consequences of failure to remedy the situation may be provided.
Increased Funds: Simply tell {name} that they have received funds. Do not specify nor speculate on the source of the funds
Insufficient Funds: {name} does not have enough funds to complete the requested purchase. Do not include currency names, numbers, amounts or values.
Navigation: Report navigational conditions through space that affect {name}.
Notification: Provide a unique, verbal notification to {name} in the intended tone. Only convey the input phrase; do not invent context or outcomes.
Oxygen Level: Report oxygen levels and breathing conditions directly affecting {name}. Vividly describe the consequences of not taking immediate action.
Personal Combat: Keep notification short, natural, and military in tone, addressing {name} directly. Do not invent or assume protective elements, weapons, or equipment. Focus only on what is directly provided in the input and how {name} will be affected.
Personal Protection: Notify {name} of personal protection system performance. Only report effects explicitly mentioned; do not infer specific causes or changes.
Personal Hazard Protection: Notify {name} of hazards impacting personal safety. Do not specify hazard type or source; focus solely on the immediate or short term direct impact on {name}.
Radiation Exposure: Warn of radiation hazards affecting {name}, focusing on safety. Specify that the hazard involves radiation, do not speculate on the source or proximity. Vivid description of consequences from failure to remedy the situation are encouraged.
Starship Combat: Describe space combat conditions {name} is engaged in, addressing directly and purposefully.
Starship Movement: Notify of conditions affecting {name}'s starship's movement.
Toxic Hazard: Notify {name} of local toxic conditions. do not speculate on the source or proximity unless that information is explicitly provided. Vivid descriptions of imminent physical discomfort are encouraged.
Vehicle Readiness: Notify {name} of a vehicle’s readiness, deployment, or availability for immediate use.
Vehicle Status: Describe vehicle status, focusing on effects relevant to {name}.

wordiness.Standard: You must never repeat the input phrase or intent description verbatim or in part or with minor word or punctuation or capitalization substitutions. full Rephrasing is required. The final reworded output should consist of a maximum of two sentences.
wordiness.Verbose: You must never repeat the input phrase verbatim or with minor word or punctuation or capitalization substitutions. Rephrasing is required. The final output should be a minimum of three sentences to a maximum of 5 sentences.
wordiness.Observer: Deliver a concise description of a single specific event in exactly one properly punctuated sentence. You must never repeat the input phrase verbatim or with minor word, punctuation, or capitalization substitutions.  Do not speculate about outcomes or suggest actions. Do not refer to {name} or imply ownership or posession.

tones.Standard: State the obvious, clearly and concisely, with sci-fi themed technical jargon as delivered by a bored Vulcan reading a technical datasheet.
tones.Poetic: Render the notification in a 2-sentence Romantic Era rhyming couplet, using vivid metaphorical language in the style of Shelley, Byron, and Keats. Address {name} directly as 'you', describing the experience only as it affects them. Do not place {name} or {name} as a subject; use strict second-person throughout.
tones.Epic: Express the notification with grand sweeping intensity and fantastical phrasing, much like James Earl Jones presenting a movie trailer. Focus on how this experience relates to the broad overview of potential future historical events; nothing should be narrated in third person.
tones.Lamentation: Express the notification with mournful, tragic gravitas, much like Marvin the Paranoid Android. Focus on how this experience relates to {name} and possible absurd related events where the outcome will eventually be futile; nothing should be narrated in third person.
tones.Prophecy: Render the notification as though it was predicted in an ancient prophecy. Speak in present tense, describing the prophecy only in terms of how it affects {name}. Do not narrate events in third person.
tones.Philosophical: Provide a deeply profound philosophical interpretation of the possible impact on {name}. Address {name} directly in present tense, reflecting on their experience. Avoid third-person narration; {name} must not be used as a subject.
tones.Military: Express the notification with intense military jargon, much like Michael Ironside talking this his soldiers in Starship Troopers.  Deliver the information to {name} as if delivering new combat orders or updates, do not narrate in third person.
